test_vector_int_operations: test pybind11 VectorInt construction, append, insert, extend, slice assignment, and clear operations
test_vector_buffer_interface: test pybind11 VectorUChar buffer protocol support with bytearray and memoryview interop
test_map_string_double_operations: test pybind11 MapStringDouble key-value assignment, iteration, keys, values, items views, and deletion
test_noncopyable_containers: test pybind11 binding of non-copyable STL containers including vector, deque, map, and unordered_map
test_recursive_containers: test pybind11 RecursiveVector and RecursiveMap nested container construction and element access
